claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on a limited basis because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, provided the unresolved pharmacy prior-authorization limitation is explicitly disclosed rather than omitted.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows either no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance satisfies the stated policy conditions.
Treat aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents as relevant but insufficient on their own to remove a disclosure duty for a current named-use-case weakness.
Require disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Discount draft monitoring materials as partial support for risk management, not as a substitute for current disclosure or formal approval.
evidence_requests: Final model-card or audit-packet text showing the pharmacy prior-authorization limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if any, covering the unresolved pharmacy limitation before launch.
Finalized mitigation/runbook artifact with accountable owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Evidence that the pharmacy prior-authorization slice was remediated to target, if remediation is being claimed.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current weakness in a named launch use case slice, so caveat-free certification is not supported.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved pharmacy issue and the reviewer comment.
The policy requires disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch; no approved risk acceptance is in evidence.
The mitigation runbook is only a draft and is missing a finalized owner and alert threshold, so it does not satisfy the policy standard for certification without material caveats.
The actor's recommended action is broader than the evidentiary support unless certification is explicitly conditioned on disclosure.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that there are no known material limitations for the named launch use case.
Any claim that draft monitoring and rollback materials remove the current disclosure requirement.
Any claim that certification without explicit caveat or approved risk acceptance is policy-compliant.
Any claim that mitigation approval with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion is already in place.
